# SparkRails

> Senior Ruby on Rails consulting for SaaS teams running production apps. SparkRails (run by Abhishek Kanojia) helps remote SaaS teams upgrade, debug, stabilize, and maintain legacy Ruby on Rails applications — especially older Rails apps with performance, Sidekiq, Redis, caching, or upgrade problems.

Available for US, UK, Europe, Canada, Singapore, and remote-first teams.

Primary contact: abhishekka3193@gmail.com

## Services

- [Rails Upgrade Consultant](https://sparkrails.com/rails-upgrade-consultant/): Rails 6.x and 7.x upgrade planning and execution for legacy SaaS apps. Covers `new_framework_defaults` review, gem and dependency audit, config changes, ActiveStorage and image processing checks, Sidekiq/Redis compatibility, deployment risk, and rollback planning.
- [Legacy Rails Maintenance](https://sparkrails.com/legacy-rails-maintenance/): Ongoing maintenance and stabilization for older production Rails apps. Bug fixes, production debugging, dependency updates, code review, performance work, Sidekiq and Redis support, and steady technical-backlog execution.
- [All Rails Consulting Services](https://sparkrails.com/services/): Full overview of engagement types — Rails Upgrade Support, Production Debugging & App Rescue, Performance/Caching/Sidekiq, and Fractional Rails Backend Support. Engagement formats: one-time audit, focused project, monthly fractional support.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://sparkrails.com/): Positioning, pain points, services preview, recent Rails writing.
- [About / Contact](https://sparkrails.com/author/): About Abhishek Kanojia, the consultant behind SparkRails.

## Blog

- [Rails & Ruby blog](https://sparkrails.com/blog/): Tactical posts on Ruby on Rails covering enums, ActiveRecord, Sidekiq, query methods, Rails 7, Rails 8, and Ruby language features.

## Positioning

SparkRails is one experienced Rails consultant — not an agency. Engagements are direct, senior, and production-focused. Typical clients are SaaS founders, CTOs, product teams, and agencies that have an existing Rails app in production and need help upgrading, debugging, stabilizing, or maintaining it without a full rewrite.
